# `grouping`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
grouping(col)
```

indicates whether a specified column in a GROUP BY is aggregated or
not, returns 1 for aggregated or 0 for not aggregated in the result set.",

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not in the function registry yet |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT name, grouping(name), sum(age) FROM VALUES (2, 'Alice'), (5, 'Bob') people(age, name) GROUP BY cube(name);
```

Result:

```text
Alice	0	2
Bob	0	5
NULL	1	7
```
